name: GalaxyCon Richmond
blurb: A four-day Richmond festival of fandom from GalaxyCon, with celebrities, voice actors, comic creators, wrestlers, cosplayers and tattoo artists.

picks: The Capital Defense Regiment of The Finest

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'GALAXYCON RICHMOND ... MARCH 18-21, 2027 ... We look forward to seeing you again March 18-21, 2027 at the Greater Richmond Convention Center'

notes: Guest cards show only name + attendance days, no bio text, so Known for is left blank throughout. Cancellations live on a separate page (galaxycon-richmond-guest-cancellations) linked from this one, not mixed into the guest grid, so (unlike galaxycon-raleigh) nothing here was excluded as cancelled. One Authentication card (JSA / 'Official Authentication & Grading Services') is a vendor service, not an individual guest, and is excluded. The console preview truncates each candidate's alt text to ~60 characters, which made #10-13 look like two image mix-ups (Zach Aguilar/Bill Farmer sharing a prefix, Bret Iwan/Christopher Sabat sharing one); the full, untruncated img URLs are in fact distinct and correctly matched per name, so all four are picked normally. Cover uses the Richmond wordmark logo for the same reason as galaxycon-raleigh: the shared og/hero images are generic multi-city or decorative assets, not edition-specific key art.
